metadata.title: The splitting of the stable space of equivariant $h$-cobordisms
metadata.abstract: We prove that the space of equivariant $h$-cobordisms on a smooth $G$-manifold $M$ has a tom Dieck style splitting, after stabilization. As an intermediate step, we introduce a space of isovariant $h$-cobordisms on $M$ and prove that this space also has a splitting, even before stabilizing. This completes the proof of the equivariant version of Waldhausen's stable parametrized $h$-cobordism theorem. Along the way, we establish several foundational results on equivariant smooth manifolds with corners.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 稳定等变h-cobordism空间的tom Dieck型分裂
analysis.workSummary: 作者证明有限群G的光滑G流形上的等变h-cobordism空间在稳定化后具有tom Dieck型分裂。中间引入isovariant h-cobordism空间，并在尚未稳定化时建立其分裂，进而完成Waldhausen稳定参数化h-cobordism定理的等变版本。
techniques: 带角等变光滑流形基础
analysis.breakthrough: 把稳定等变h-cobordism与分裂结构联系起来，并补足带角等变光滑几何的若干基础结果。
analysis.limitations: 正文第8页明确G为固定有限群，并要求带角G流形的作用沿角平凡；不能推广至任意紧Lie群或所有角上作用。普通等变空间分裂是在稳定化后，不能由isovariant情形推为稳定化前也成立。当前解读结合摘要与第7–8页声明及背景，未逐步审读证明。
